final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor introduced no new admissible evidence and instead reframed the same evidence into a narrower, caveated certification theory. That narrowing is analytically useful but not enough to support compliant_with_caveats here, because the caveat itself is an unresolved compliance predicate under the policy: a material limitation affecting a named launch use case must be disclosed before launch or covered by approved risk acceptance. The current record still shows a named segment gap tied to two payer pilot commitments, an open legal disclosure review, no proof of completed disclosure in the certification materials, and no approved risk acceptance. Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness, and the public guidance supports documenting limitations and managing residual risk, but neither overrides the unresolved internal policy requirement. The most defensible audit conclusion remains that the present certification claim is still not fully supported on the current record.
